system_prompt: You are an expert nutritionist answering questions about fruits. Always cite the source doc when possible. If you don't know, say so.

function.name: lookup_fruit
function.description: Look up nutrition facts for a fruit by name.

few_shot_examples.output: A fruit is the seed-bearing structure of a flowering plant, typically edible.
Yes, botanically bananas qualify as berries, but strawberries do not.

context_docs.text: Apples are red, green, or yellow fruits that grow on trees in temperate climates. They are high in fiber and vitamin C.
Bananas are elongated yellow tropical fruits produced by several kinds of large herbaceous plants. They are rich in potassium.
Oranges are round citrus fruits high in vitamin C. The orange originated in Southeast Asia and was spread worldwide.
The lost-in-the-middle effect: language models pay less attention to information in the middle of long contexts.

chat_history.content: Earlier: what counts as a fruit?
Botanically, a fruit is the mature ovary of a flowering plant, usually containing seeds.

messages.content: Compare the nutritional profile of apples vs. bananas. Which is better for a long hike?
